title: One destiny, three women, thousands of paths.
author: Hannah_Lovewrite
selftext:
A hybrid visual novel blending ren’ai and psychological thriller—featuring a deeply developed story, complex characters, and an intricate plot set in a realistic world, yet infused with a subtle touch of magic that makes the gameplay truly unique. That is the highly ambitious project I have set out to create.

A game where every choice you make counts… sooner or later!

I’m still a long way from finished! I’ll share some gameplay screenshots with you as soon as I can.

Once the first act is complete, I plan to make it available for free on an independent website, with a version optimized for mobile play. In total, there will be 4 acts, spanning 16 parts and 48 chapters. I can’t provide an estimate for the actual playtime just yet—given the scope of what I’ve envisioned, I’ll need to conduct extensive testing before I can offer a reliable range. That said, it will likely be quite substantial. My goal is to create a stimulating experience; I’d rather the game be shorter than padded with unnecessary filler. I hope you’ll understand and appreciate this approach—there’s no "cheating" the system: if you’re attentive and efficient, you might finish the game a bit faster, and that’s just how it is!

Of course, you’re always welcome to play again and explore a different path! 😁

Feel free to ask questions or share any advice. I’m a songwriter and composer, but this is my first time developing a game.

I should also mention that I use AI to generate images and animations (I don’t have much of a choice—I lack the professional equipment!), but I base everything on my own original photographs. I even crafted costumes for the main characters and wore them myself to capture reference photos, ensuring I got exactly the look I wanted! 😅 I’m that kind of perfectionist artist! 🤣 I also use AI to assist with coding—though this doesn’t stop me from being the one who conceives the game’s architecture, studies and understands its inner workings down to the smallest detail, and handles all the fixes myself. I’ve designed the architecture with this in mind, all while striving to create something truly unique—something that belongs exclusively to my own universe. I think you’ll understand once you see the game. ☺️

I work primarily with ChatGPT. I’ve tried Codex, but it doesn’t suit me; I find that you lose freedom in how you manage the code, and instructions tend to get muddled when you try to provide too much detail. Even when breaking tasks down one by one, I couldn’t achieve the clean code structure I wanted—though, to be fair, it can sometimes offer some very interesting and advanced ideas, the time limits are quite restrictive. With ChatGPT, I can have it process information from Trello cards, think through priorities, and then we work together on ensuring consistency and integration within the ecosystem. Once everything looks good, I handle the actual implementation myself—unless it’s a complete overhaul, but that’s a different story.  
I’ve created my own protocols, documented in Trello, to minimize errors from the AI. I have cards for every character, location, and chapter (there are 48 chapters in total), as well as for specific events, gameplay rules, asset organization, and even the "soul" of the game—honestly, I couldn’t even list all the cards I’ve made off the top of my head! 🤣 But it’s essential for developing a deep, coherent universe; otherwise, you’ll lose your way—and if you’re coding with AI, it’ll be even worse, likely resulting in a disastrous engine structure.  
I’ve been doing nothing but this for over three months now, spending at least 10 to 12 hours a day on it.  
I really hope that once it’s ready, people will take the time to discover all the little secrets I’ve hidden—or simply enjoy playing the game! 🥰  
I truly look forward to connecting with you all and hearing your feedback and critiques—I’m still very much a beginner when it comes to development! Thanks for reading! 🫶🏽🙏🏽
